mechanism.claim: A large completed daily change in the Cboe RVX/VIX ratio isolates a small-cap risk-appetite shock relative to broad US equity volatility. When BTC is already in a high realized-variation regime before the next US session, rising relative small-cap volatility maps short BTC and falling relative small-cap volatility maps long BTC for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: negative sign of the completed delta log(RVX/VIX)

external_support.RVX: Cboe Russell 2000 Volatility Index: expected 30-day Russell 2000 volatility
external_support.VIX: Cboe Volatility Index: expected 30-day S&P 500 volatility
external_support.untested_adaptation: the relative-volatility shock is tested as a BTC risk-appetite relay

mechanism.why_distinct: No prior repository alpha uses RVX. Existing volatility-rotation relays use Nasdaq, gold, oil, or crypto implied volatility; VVIX candidates measure convexity rather than small-cap stress.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC prior-24h realized variation must have a causal rank of at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: an external daily small-cap volatility shock with next-session 09:35 ET entry is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.relative_volatility: log(RVX_close/VIX_close) on exact common Cboe source dates
features.shock: current relative_volatility minus immediately previous exact common-source observation
features.shock_z: (shock-current strict-prior mean)/strict-prior sample std over at most 252 prior finite shocks; minimum 126; current excluded; sample std positive
features.shock_gate: absolute shock_z >= 1.0; side uses the unstandardized shock sign; zero is ineligible
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared log(close/open)) over 1,440 exact BTCUSDT 1m bars ending at, but excluding, the next exact Cboe source date 09:30 America/New_York
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 252 previous exact Cboe-source-date BTC variations; minimum 126; current excluded; rank >= 0.65

clock.decision: after next exact common Cboe source date 09:30 America/New_York BTC variation is complete
clock.entry: same source date exact BTCUSDT 09:35 America/New_York 5m open
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: official RVX/VIX economic definitions plus the user-required high-volatility BTC regime

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, side, hold, timing, volatility, or subset repair
